::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 1st 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS NLS 3553/70
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Thank you for seeing to the books.  The thanks for them from Wantage arrived the day before yesterday, but I could not write before as I only came home from Oxfordshire and am paying the price of my four days holiday by having more letters to answer than I can manage[^1]

yours truly
C M Yonge

Did I say how charmed I was with your bright little sister in law?[^2]

---

[^1]: She had arranged for a set of her novels to be sent to the [Community of St. Mary the Virgin, Wantage](organizations/other_21.qmd), for transmission to their convent in Bombay.
[^2]: Perhaps [Fanny Esther Duffield](people/person_2310.qmd) (1849-1923) who married (1873) Craik's younger brother Henry Craik (1846-1927), an examiner in the Education Department.
